summary: Completed comprehensive testing of FOMO AI Economics feature (Phase 1). Backend APIs and frontend UI fully functional with 100% test pass rate. All economic calculations verified to be mathematically correct.

backend_issues.notes: Backend returning 201 (Created) instead of 200 (OK) for simulate endpoint, but this is acceptable and data is correct.

passed_tests: Backend: Admin login successful with JWT token
Backend: GET /api/admin/entitlements/ai/economics returns correct defaults (price=$49, period=30d, credits=1000, targetMargin=0.5, paymentFee=0.03, infra=0.07)
Backend: Budget calculations correct (netRevenue=$44.10, allowedAiCost=$22.05, maxCostPerCredit=$0.02205)

Backend: POST /api/admin/entitlements/ai/economics/simulate with 70% utilization returns correct values (expectedConsumedCredits=700, expectedAiCogsUsd=$15.435, estimatedGrossMarginPct=65%, worstCaseGrossMarginPct=50%)

Backend: POST /api/admin/entitlements/ai/economics/simulate with overrides (price=$59, credits=800, targetMargin=0.6) calculates correctly (netRevenue=$53.10, allowedAiCost=$21.24, maxCostPerCredit=$0.02655)
Frontend: AI-кредиты tab found and clickable
Frontend: Экономика subtab found and clickable
Frontend: Budget cards display correct values (Net revenue $44.10, Allowed AI COGS $22.05, Max cost/credit $0.02205)
Frontend: Target gross margin input (data-testid=econ-targetGrossMarginPct) works with live updates
Frontend: Utilization input (data-testid=econ-util) works with live updates
Frontend: Simulator recalculates correctly when inputs change (verified with target margin 0.6 → Est. margin 68%, Worst-case 60%)
Frontend: Save button (data-testid=econ-save) is visible and enabled
Math verification: All formulas correct (NetRevenue = Price × (1-PaymentFee-Infra), AllowedAiCost = NetRevenue × (1-TargetMargin), MaxCostPerCredit = AllowedAiCost / IncludedCredits)
